children: Each Week, the Weekly Edge Case turns the spotlight on a single company surfaced by Market Edge to show the framework, Quality Rating combined with Market Edge's Value and Momentum, at work on one concrete name. This week's case is a quality serial acquirer that screens in a combination worth pausing on: still Cheap on Value, yet already trading with a Strong tailwind. When a name is genuinely cheap and the market has begun to agree, it earns a closer look.

This is a press release from Redeye Nordic Growth AB, a equity research firm specializing in Nordic growth companies within Tech and Life Science. Redeye Nordic Growth is a part of the Redeye group, which also offers services within corporate finance advisory and fund management. https://services.redeye.se/
